_doc: REVIEWED exclusion list of listed symbols whose data is knowingly unusable for the screener simulation. Read by the panel build (recorded in the manifest as excluded_unusable, printed) and by the launch (printed; the gate never selects them). Never a silent tolerance: every entry needs a symbol, a reason, a date and a reviewer; a build prints entries that were not needed.
